name: list_years
title: List Supported Bangladesh Tax Years
description: List supported Bangladesh fiscal/income years (FY 2023-24 through FY 2026-27), corresponding assessment years, slab rates, general thresholds, taxpayer categories, locations, salary exemption rules, and investment instrument caps.

name: get_rules
title: Get Bangladesh Tax Rules for Fiscal Year
description: Return thresholds, parent-of-disabled allowance, progressive tax slabs, investment rebate formula/caps, minimum tax by location, and salary exemption caps for a Bangladesh Fiscal Year without calculating tax on an income.

category.description: Taxpayer category: "general", "female", "senior" (65+), "disabled", "third_gender", "freedom_fighter" (gazetted war-wounded / July Warrior), or legacy "parent_disabled".

age.description: Taxpayer age in whole years (optional; age >= 65 promotes general/female to senior threshold in FY 2025-26 and FY 2026-27).

parent_of_disabled.description: True if parent or legal guardian of a person with disability (+BDT 50,000 threshold).

name: calculate_tax
title: Calculate Bangladesh Personal Income Tax
description: Calculate Bangladesh salaried personal income tax for a Fiscal Year (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26, or 2026-27). Accepts either post-exemption taxable_income OR salary income components (annual or monthly), taxpayer profile (category, age, parent_of_disabled, location, first_time_filer), investments, and TDS. Returns threshold used, taxable income, slab-by-slab breakdown, gross tax, rebate, minimum tax, and final payable tax.

category.description: Taxpayer category: "general", "female", "senior" (65+), "disabled", "third_gender", "freedom_fighter" (gazetted war-wounded / July Warrior), or legacy "parent_disabled".

age.description: Taxpayer age in whole years (optional; age >= 65 promotes general/female to senior threshold in FY 2025-26 and FY 2026-27).

parent_of_disabled.description: True if parent or legal guardian of a person with disability (+BDT 50,000 additive threshold).

location.description: Taxpayer location for minimum tax rules: "dhaka", "chittagong", "other_city" (other city corporations), or "district" (non-city-corporation areas).

first_time_filer.description: True if first-time tax return filer (applies BDT 1,000 minimum tax in FY 2025-26 and FY 2026-27 when above threshold).

taxable_income.description: Annual post-exemption taxable income in BDT. Mutually exclusive with income.

period.description: Whether recurring salary fields (basic, house, medical, transport, lfa, others, or gross_salary) are monthly (multiplied by 12) or annual. Bonus fields are always annual.

gross_salary.description: Unitemized gross employment salary in BDT (mutually exclusive with basic/house/medical/transport/lfa/employer_rpf/others). Receives the ITA 2023 Sixth Schedule Part 1 Para 27 single-pool exemption min(1/3 of gross, cap) unless apply_exemption is false.

use_standard_breakdown.description: When true alongside gross_salary, populates illustrative 60% basic, 25% house, 10% medical, 5% transport components.

apply_exemption.description: When true (default), deducts the ITA 2023 Sixth Schedule Part 1 Para 27 single-pool employment exemption min(1/3 of gross employment income, BDT 500,000; BDT 450,000 in FY 2023-24).

basic.description: Basic salary in BDT (part of gross employment income pool).

house.description: House rent allowance in BDT (part of gross employment income pool).

medical.description: Medical allowance in BDT (part of gross employment income pool).

transport.description: Conveyance/transport allowance in BDT (part of gross employment income pool).

lfa.description: Leave fare assistance in BDT (part of gross employment income pool).

employer_rpf.description: Employer contribution to Recognized Provident Fund (RPF) in BDT (part of gross employment income pool).

others.description: Other recurring taxable allowances in BDT.

bonus.description: Annual festival/performance bonus in BDT (always annual, fully taxable).

bonus2.description: Second annual bonus in BDT (always annual, fully taxable).

additional_income.description: Additional annual lump-sum taxable salary income in BDT.

income.description: Salary components in BDT. Mutually exclusive with top-level taxable_income.

investments.description: Eligible tax-rebate investments in BDT (number or itemized object).

total.description: Total eligible investment in BDT (mutually exclusive with itemized fields).

dps.description: Deposit Pension Scheme (DPS) contribution in BDT (instrument cap BDT 120,000).

life_insurance.description: Life insurance premium in BDT (requires life_insurance_policy_value when > 0; capped at 10% of policy sum assured).

life_insurance_policy_value.description: Total policy sum assured in BDT for life_insurance; caps eligible premium at 10% of policy sum assured per Sixth Schedule Part 3.

savings_certificate.description: Sanchayapatra / savings certificate investment in BDT (instrument cap BDT 500,000).

mutual_fund.description: Mutual fund / unit certificate investment in BDT (cap BDT 500,000 through FY 2024-25; uncapped from FY 2025-26 onward per Finance Act 2026).

apply_instrument_caps.description: Statutory Sixth Schedule Part 3 instrument caps are always enforced on itemized investments (DPS <= 120,000, savings_certificate <= 500,000, life_insurance <= 10% of policy value, mutual_fund <= 500,000 through FY 2024-25 and uncapped in FY 2025-26/2026-27).

tds.description: Total annual Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) already withheld in BDT.

name: compare_years
title: Compare Bangladesh Income Tax Across Two Fiscal Years
description: Run side-by-side Bangladesh income tax calculations for two Fiscal Years (defaults to 2025-26 vs 2026-27) using identical taxpayer profile, income, investments, and TDS. Returns full breakdowns for both years plus threshold, gross tax, rebate, total tax, and payable tax differences.
